title: Finite labelled copies and fibre-normalized universal sections
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme and $W\to U$ an object of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For each profinite set $P$, let $W[P]$ be the profinite-copy object of $W$, retained over $U$, functorially in $P$ [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. Fix an algebraically closed field $\Omega$, a geometric point $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$, and a lift $w:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to W$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. For $q\in P$, its labelled neighbourhood is $W[P]$ with geometric point the composite of $w$ and the constant-$q$ section $W\to W[P]$. For a set sheaf $F$ on $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$, a finite set $A$, and a universal section $s\in F(W[A])$, its labelled germ at $q\in A$ is the image of $s$ under the coprojection from that labelled neighbourhood into the geometric stalk $F_y$ [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Given a bijection $e:A\cong F_y$, call $s$ fibre-normalized if (i) for every pro-etale object $V\to W$, the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{W}(V,W[A])\to F(V)$ sending $f$ to $f^*s$ is bijective, and (ii) for every $q\in A$ its labelled germ is $e(q)$. Finally, $F$ is finite constant at $W$ if there is a finite set $A$ and an isomorphism $F|_W\cong\underline A_W$, using the actual inverse-image functor [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Empty finite label sets are allowed. The Lean label set is lifted by $\mathrm{ULift}$ to the stalk's universe.

def IsAbelianTowerNormalizedSection {U : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u}
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U} (W : U.ProEt)
    (w : Over.mk y ⟶ (Scheme.ProEt.forget U).obj W)
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) (Type (u + 1))) (A : FintypeCat.{u})
    (e : ULift.{u + 1, u} A ≃ Scheme.proEtaleGeometricSetStalk y F)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op ((abelianTowerLabels W).obj (FintypeCat.toProfinite.obj A)))) :
    Prop
